tools.name: lemonsqueezy_get_user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated user/account behind the API key. Good first call to confirm auth. API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_stores
tools.description: List all stores in the account. API: GET /stores.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_get_store
tools.description: Get a single store by id. API: GET /stores/{id}.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_products
tools.description: List products, optionally filtered to one store. API: GET /products (filter[store_id]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_variants
tools.description: List variants (price/plan tiers), optionally filtered to one product. API: GET /variants (filter[product_id]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_prices
tools.description: List price models, optionally filtered to one variant. API: GET /prices (filter[variant_id]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally filtered by store and/or email. API: GET /customers (filter[store_id], filter[email]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_get_customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id. API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, optionally filtered by store and/or buyer email. API: GET /orders (filter[store_id], filter[user_email]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_get_order
tools.description: Get a single order by id. API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions with rich filtering by store, status, product, variant, customer, or buyer email. API: GET /subscriptions (filter[store_id], filter[status], filter[product_id], filter[variant_id], filter[customer_id], filter[user_email]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_get_subscription
tools.description: Get a single subscription by id. API: GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_subscription_invoices
tools.description: List subscription invoices, optionally filtered by store, status, or refunded flag. API: GET /subscription-invoices (filter[store_id], filter[status], filter[refunded]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_license_keys
tools.description: List license keys, optionally filtered by store, order, or product. API: GET /license-keys (filter[store_id], filter[order_id], filter[product_id]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_list_discounts
tools.description: List discounts, optionally filtered to one store. API: GET /discounts (filter[store_id]).

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_create_checkout
tools.description: WRITE: Create a hosted checkout / payment link for a store + variant. Returns the created checkout including its `url` (the shareable payment link). API: POST /checkouts.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_update_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Modify a LIVE subscription — change plan/tier (variant_id), cancel, pause/unpause, or set the billing anchor. This affects a real customer's billing. API: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: lemonsqueezy_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: Cancel a LIVE subscription. It remains active until the end of the current billing period, then moves to `cancelled`. This affects a real customer. API: DELETE /subscriptions/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lemonsqueezy_list_customers, lemonsqueezy_list_orders, lemonsqueezy_list_subscriptions · Private data: lemonsqueezy_get_user · Public sink: lemonsqueezy_list_customers, lemonsqueezy_list_orders, lemonsqueezy_list_subscriptions, lemonsqueezy_create_checkout · Destructive: lemonsqueezy_update_subscription, lemonsqueezy_cancel_customer_subscription.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lemonsqueezy_list_customers, lemonsqueezy_list_orders, lemonsqueezy_list_subscriptions · Private data: lemonsqueezy_get_user · Public sink: lemonsqueezy_list_customers, lemonsqueezy_list_orders, lemonsqueezy_list_subscriptions, lemonsqueezy_create_checkout · Destructive: lemonsqueezy_update_subscription, lemonsqueezy_cancel_customer_subscription

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
